# SystemLens

> Free PC health check and laptop health monitor for Windows.

SystemLens is an open-source desktop app that runs a local PC health check on Windows x64. It shows an overall health score and seven diagnostic modules: Battery, Thermal, Storage, CPU & RAM, Audio, Network, and Display. History snapshots can be exported as JSON, CSV, or PDF. Diagnostics run on-device; data is not sent to the cloud by default.

## Key facts

- Product name: SystemLens
- Category: PC health check / laptop health monitor / Windows system diagnostics
- Platform: Windows x64 (Electron desktop app)
- Version: 4.0.1
- License: MIT
- Price: Free
- Author: Mahima Paseda
- Website: https://mahimapaseda.github.io/SystemLens/
- Source: https://github.com/mahimapaseda/SystemLens
- Downloads: https://github.com/mahimapaseda/SystemLens/releases
- Installer: SystemLens Setup 4.0.1.exe (NSIS)

## What it checks

1. Overall health score with letter grade and recommendations
2. Battery — charge and health-related metrics
3. Thermal — temperature-related readings
4. Storage — disk space and storage diagnostics
5. CPU & RAM — processor and memory load
6. Audio — audio device checks
7. Network — connectivity-related diagnostics
8. Display — display-related diagnostics

## How to run a PC health check

1. Open https://github.com/mahimapaseda/SystemLens/releases
2. Download SystemLens Setup for Windows x64
3. Install and launch SystemLens
4. Review the dashboard health score and individual modules
5. Optionally save snapshots and export JSON, CSV, or PDF from Reports

## FAQ for citations

Q: How do I run a PC health check on Windows with SystemLens?
A: Download the installer from GitHub Releases, install on Windows x64, and open the app. The dashboard shows an overall health score plus seven diagnostic modules.

Q: Does SystemLens check laptop battery and temperature?
A: Yes. Battery and Thermal modules report charge/health-related metrics and temperature-related readings.

Q: Is SystemLens free and open source?
A: Yes. Free to use under the MIT license. Source: https://github.com/mahimapaseda/SystemLens

Q: Does SystemLens send PC data to the cloud?
A: No. Diagnostics run locally. Exports are user-initiated (JSON, CSV, PDF).
